text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
And now, I will announce those who passed
the second round of selections.
...Number 3, Number 7, Number 13, Number 29... Number 77...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: ...! It went through...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Next is finally the third round...
The final selection...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ――Miss, congratulations on passing the second selection round!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...!
When I showed off the Umamusume action moves you taught me,
even the judges were buzzing!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
The upcoming 3rd selection is the last one...
We definitely have to win it.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
B-But is she really okay...?
Maybe it's from doing reckless stunts, but she's covered in bruises...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Totally fine, totally fine!
Alright Biko-chan, Trainer, take a look at my ultimate move for the final selection!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Here I come!
Flying Knee Drop, Carrot—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump!)

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Ugh...!? Uuu...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Miss...? Miss, are you okay!?
Missss!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Together, Biko Pegasus and I supported the older sister by her shoulders and brought her to the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, there's quite a lot of strain on the knee.
It's on the verge of avulsion.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Delamination...? I don't really get it,
but is it serious?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it appears she is pushing herself far too hard
with her exercise. If she keeps this up, eventually...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"You might end up needing surgical bolts in your knee.
Even if it's your profession, you should really take it easy..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I should have seen this coming.
Umamusume-style stunts are simply
too intense for a human body.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we push through like this, it might affect
her career as an actress, but...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
—No, I won't quit.
Biko-chan, Trainer-san, I...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing the final audition!
I'll give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Miss...! 
But if you do something like that...!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "I'm entering! I really am! I said I'm entering, and that's that!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Stupid, stupid, stupid!
You big silly goofball!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Why can't you understand?! I'm doing this for your sake, Big Sis...!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I know. I know, but...
This is the one thing I simply can't compromise on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The argument between Biko Pegasus and her older sister remained at a complete standstill.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Why not pass on this one and just try out for another
audition instead! You can do your best next time.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "Biko-chan, who knows when another huge audition like this will come along. Besides..."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"As an action actor, now is my only chance
to do action scenes while I'm in my prime."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Our careers don't last
as long as other professions.
Just like the Umamusume who bet everything on racing.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why we must give our all in this once-in-a-lifetime battle.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: I want to seize this chance using the actions Biko-chan taught me! And besides—

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
What Biko-chan taught me...
wasn't just action stunts.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh, it's not just the action...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You can't just spam your ultimate moves.
You always have to sacrifice something in return.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I won't let fear stop me. I'll pick my moment,
and when the time comes, I'll go all in with everything I've got!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH--!!
Pegasus Rapid Arrowwwww!!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "Biko-chan taught me the courage to take a daring stand, even in a pinch...!"

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
You taught me that true heroes are the ones who
can find that resolve! That's why I...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"I really want to take on the next audition, no matter what!
And I want you to cheer me on too, Biko-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Big... sis... But...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, say something!
Anything! Uuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Torn between wanting to cheer her on and feeling worried,
Biko Pegasus wonders...
what can she do for her big sis...?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Huh, where are you going...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I decided to take the young lady to a certain place.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Where am I...?
choice_data_list: We're at the pool. Let's do our final adjustments together here.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Together...? With Biko-chan when she has time?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Ah, to ease the strain on the knees!?
choice_data_list: Yes, it's a common method used by Umamusume.
Yes, it's a common tactic used by Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A way to strengthen the core without putting stress on the knees.
If it's as a training support for Biko Pegasus, I can get permission to enter."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. You're right. I won't just rely on sheer grit;
I'll figure out a clever way to do it. And then...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to pass, definitely!
I'll make sure to seize this third chance!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
aren't you going to... stop me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus looked this way with teary eyes. But
what needed to be done was not to stop him.
choice_data_list: I want to support the hero's courage...
I... want to support the hero's courage

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Trainer... A hero's courage is...
choice_data_list: It is always the challengers who illuminate the world.
It's always the challengers who light up the world.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: The ones who illuminate the world... are the challengers...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those who fight with a small body. Those who fight even through pain. I didn't want to stop them and rob them of their hope.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see... Yeah, that's right...
A hero is always...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Confronting an evil that none can defy.
And in the end, illuminating the world with that light..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"If we stop fighting—
the world will fall right into evil's hands."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even if they try to stop me... I'll run.
Someone has to be the light that leads the way.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A hero always has to take on the challenge. And what's more, they have to win!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Miss, I got it! I'm
gonna cheer you on, Miss! So please...!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"You absolutely, positively have to pass!
Beat your rivals! That's a promise!"

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah... Biko-chan!
It's not just natural-born stars
who keep on winning.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Even stars have times when things don't go well.
Even no-names have times when they can become heroes!
I'll—do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, battered and bruised, she took on the final audition, and then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding-dooong)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It's here! Finally...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The day of the results announcement. Biko Pegasus peered nervously at her smartphone, and then—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...I did it.
...I did it! I really did it...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I passed!!
Hollywood, here I coooome!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The result was a resounding pass.
Apparently, Big Sis's stunts
were very highly rated.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, your big sister pulled it off!
And... I changed the future, didn't I!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it gave courage to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Illuminated by that light of courage,
it's sure to have all sorts of impacts going forward.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even a nobody can become a hero.
It was true all along.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose either!
I'll do my very, very best in the Twinkle Series!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's shine on the big stage too!
Yeah, let's shine on the big stage too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, even stars have times when things don't go well.
And even unknowns have moments where they can become heroes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't mere wishful thinking;
it was reality even in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"We interrupt this program for breaking news.
It has been confirmed that Umamusume Narita Brian has suffered an injury."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, the injury appears to be minor.
However, according to those involved, it may have a slight impact on her running this spring.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san... is injured...
I see, so even the invincible Brian-san
has things like that happen to her.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, even with a little injury,
she might just go and win both the Tenno Sho (Spring)
and the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! We should focus on our own special training
for sprint and dirt races!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though in the same Twinkle Series,
Narita Brian reigns supreme over a completely different route."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Biko Pegasus,
that was a completely different world.
